verdict.rationale: Conductor's cloud offering documents sandboxes in which agents run, test repositories, edit setup scripts and run builds without per-step confirmation, so the agent can operate inside a sandboxed environment. Local workspaces are only separate git worktrees, not containers, as the developer notes, so worktree file isolation is not counted as a sandbox. Missing for 10: documented isolation boundaries for tools and network access (egress controls, allowlists), sandboxing for local runs, and independent hands-on corroboration of the cloud sandbox's isolation.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can have the agent operate inside a sandbox when interacting with code, tools, and network resources

citations.quote: Sandboxes spin up in seconds, and agents keep working after you close your laptop.
The agent can test your repositories, update install and setup scripts, and run builds — without asking you to confirm each step.
You can also have an agent configure the computer for you: it can test your repositories, edit setup scripts, and run builds.
